intent: Sum available-today units of the specified Makita Workshop Drill Grinder and Sander (drill press, 230 V) across all open Vienna PowerTool branches and cite each included store record plus the product record.

params.family_name: Makita Workshop DDF OIE-YYP Workshop Drill Grinder and Sander

success_criteria: Product variant resolved by brand=Makita, product_family_name=the named line, property machine_type='drill press', property voltage_v=230
Inventory scoped to stores where city='Vienna' (branches visitable today)
Total = SUM(available_today_quantity) over matched Vienna stores having available_today_quantity > 0
refs cite the record_path of every included (available) Vienna store plus the matched product record_path; no zero/unavailable store or unrelated path

args.stdin:
WITH target AS (
  SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN product_families pf ON pf.product_family_id = pv.product_family_id
  JOIN product_variant_properties mt ON mt.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND mt.property_key = 'machine_type' AND mt.property_value_text = :machine_type
  JOIN product_variant_properties vv ON vv.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND vv.property_key = 'voltage_v' AND vv.property_value_number = :voltage_v
  WHERE pv.brand = :brand AND pf.product_family_name = :family_name
),
vienna AS (
  SELECT store_id, record_path FROM stores WHERE city = :city AND is_open = 1
)
SELECT v.store_id,
       v.record_path AS store_record_path,
       t.product_sku,
       t.record_path AS product_record_path,
       si.available_today_quantity,
       (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(si2.available_today_quantity),0)
          FROM store_inventory si2
          JOIN vienna v2 ON v2.store_id = si2.store_id
          JOIN target t2 ON t2.product_sku = si2.product_sku
         WHERE si2.available_today_quantity > 0) AS total_units
FROM vienna v
JOIN store_inventory si ON si.store_id = v.store_id
JOIN target t ON t.product_sku = si.product_sku
WHERE si.available_today_quantity > 0;

agents_md_constraints.rule: When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
When answering availability questions - answer should reference products that are available, but should not reference unavailable products. Same with stores.
